fn logical_or(x1: List[Bool], x2: List[Bool]) -> List[Bool]
  requires (len(x1) == len(x2))
  ensures (len(result) == len(x1))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): (result[i] == (x1[i] or x2[i]))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): ((x1[i] or x2[i]) == (x2[i] or x1[i]))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(x1): ((x1[i] or false) == x1[i])
  ensures forall i in 0..len(x1): ((x1[i] or true) == true)
  ensures forall i in 0..len(x1): ((x1[i] or x1[i]) == x1[i])
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): ((not ((x1[i] == true) or (x2[i] == true))) or (result[i] == true))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): ((not ((x1[i] == false) and (x2[i] == false))) or (result[i] == false))
  effects pure
  example (logical_or([], []) == [])
